# The Quiet Hub

> Calming background music, ambient noise and natural sounds for studying, focusing, working, sleeping and meditating.

The Quiet Hub is a small library of background audio. Music playlists are curated from independent artists. Nature and noise collections are original recordings. Listening happens on Spotify, Apple Music or YouTube Music.

## Site

- [Home](https://thequiethub.com/): landing and playlist collection
- [Music](https://thequiethub.com/music/): playlist collection (same homepage, scrolled to the grid)
- [What is The Quiet Hub?](https://thequiethub.com/what-is-the-quiet-hub/)
- [Articles](https://thequiethub.com/articles/): Research-led guides to background sound
